name: Brother Tobin Ashe
bio: Kindleby's bell-porter and a candle-warden: a lay brother, Kindleby-born, nineteen, never been to the Spire (he was to be called up this midwinter). Rings the quay bell for every boat — one, then three: a boat seen, and welcome — and keeps his forty candles on the sea wall lit, turn and turn, as every brother and sister on the island has since the Snuffing.
